message:
The other day, we had a little scare with a storm warning, and I found myself rummaging through the closet to gather our go-bags. It was a bit chaotic, but the best part was our family group chat lighting up with messages. My daughter sent a list of what to pack, my son chimed in with a joke about how we’d be camping in the living room, and my husband reminded me to grab the important documents. 

In the midst of the packing frenzy, I realized that staying prepared doesn’t have to feel heavy or stressful; it can be a team effort, even if it’s just through a screen. It’s comforting to know we can lean on each other, no matter the circumstances. Have you ever had a moment like that with your family?
